answer: Latency-Weighted Contribution Ledger. Each new identity's payouts unlock only after 30 days of sustained useful work, with rewards weighted by a decaying trust score seeded from prior verified output. A clone farm must fund full compute and labor for a month per identity before earning anything, and any fable of fast returns dies against this delay. Rewards vest against a tundra of idle capacity the attacker must carry. Slashing of pending rewards on cross-identity correlation makes marginal clones negative-EV, since detected clusters forfeit basalt-hard accrued credit.
